marketing_description: The DeWALT DCD803B Cordless High Torque Impact Driver features a 1/2 in keyless metal chuck, 20 V voltage rating, and 1650 RPM speed rating. It includes a 1/2 in metal chuck attachment, 1/4 in Hex right angle attachment, 1/4 in Hex quick release attachment, and 1/4 in Hex quick release offset attachment. This tool is designed for use with a trigger switch and main handle.
